thread:
Clare Patel: Thanks for the great attendance — pulling together the runtime Q&A action items from today's all-hands. I added what I captured below; please correct me and add owners.

Matt Johnson: Question first — on batching/caching tuning, are we prioritizing latency SLO or cost reductions for v1? we need to be explicit.

Clare Patel: Prioritize latency SLO for customer-facing routes (p95 target). Cost reductions via batching are secondary but important for background/batch routes.

Alex Lee: Observed a small throughput dip in the canary when microbatching hit 10k queued tokens. Dash link: https://dash.internal/redwood/runtime/canary-2345 — looks like kernel v2 path falls back to slow attention kernel.

Jun Park: I saw the same. Pod logs show repeated kernel fallback on long sequences. snippet:```2025-03-11T15:12:04Z runtime kernel: fallback to generic_attn k=512 seq=4096 reason=tile_mismatch```. Could be kernel selection heuristic.

Sara Morales: Ops note — the canary also had some pod churn (OOMs) after rolling kernel v2. I'm collecting kube events. Might be memory accounting for KV cache.

Matt Johnson: Action: I'll open a short PR to add a stricter selection threshold and a logging flag so we can see why the fallback triggers. Will reference PR #4132.

Alex Lee: Action: I'll add a perf test in the benchmarking harness that emulates long context sequences (3k-5k) and run against kernel v1/v2. Assigning to me.

Eve Chen: From infra side — let's not change the global heuristic without a canary gating policy. Suggest we add a runtime feature flag and toggle per-cluster. I can add that toggle by EOD.

Clare Patel: Good call on a per-cluster flag. Also, follow-up question from leadership: what's the short-term rollout plan for KV cache TTL changes?

Jun Park: Proposal: keep default TTL but expose TTL profile per-model. This avoids global regressions. Also add TTL telemetry to the console to track hit rate.

Sara Morales: Agree. I'll add console telemetry card for KV hit/miss and TTL distribution. Starting a ticket.

Matt Johnson: Quick note — batching changes affect cost reporting; we need to ensure token accounting remains accurate when we coalesce requests. I'll work with billing to validate.

Clare Patel: Summary of owners and next steps: Matt -> PR for kernel threshold + logging (#4132) / Alex -> perf harness long-context tests / Eve -> per-cluster feature flag / Sara -> KV telemetry card / Jun -> TTL-per-model proposal doc. Please drop links in this thread when created.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for kernel v2 on cluster us-west-2-canary — watch https://deploys.internal/redwood/2345678901

Alex Lee: will post perf run results here by tomorrow.

Jun Park: I'll sketch the TTL profile proposal and ping Clare for priority.

Clare Patel: Thanks all — if anyone else had a question during the all-hands that I missed, add it here. Otherwise we'll track progress and recheck in next sync. :thumbsup:
